stem: Which electrolyte abnormalities should the nurse recognize as established risks of hydrochlorothiazide therapy?
rationale: Hydrochlorothiazide labeling warns that fluid and electrolyte imbalance can include hyponatremia and hypokalemia. Monitoring is appropriate, particularly in clients at higher risk or when symptoms suggest imbalance.
educational_objective: Recognize hyponatremia and hypokalemia as important electrolyte disturbances associated with hydrochlorothiazide.
source_organization: DailyMed / U.S. National Library of Medicine
source_locator: Precautions — General / Laboratory Tests: fluid and electrolyte imbalance including hyponatremia and hypokalemia
source_claim_supported: Hydrochlorothiazide can cause electrolyte disturbances including hyponatremia and hypokalemia.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
